project_name: AWS Birchwood / King George data center campus
developer: Amazon Data Services / Birchwood Power Partners
status_detail: King George approved rezoning/proffers/special exception for Amazon's former Birchwood power plant campus in September 2023; later county leadership tried to revisit the agreement and Amazon filed vested-rights litigation, so the project is approved but contested/on hold.
notes: County performance-agreement report says Amazon intended $6B investment by 2040 at the former Birchwood power plant and surrounding Sealston properties. Public reports describe 869 acres, 17-19 buildings, and roughly 7.25M-7.5M sq ft.

status_detail: Board of Supervisors voted 3-2 in February 2026 to rezone approximately 300 acres from Agricultural to Industrial and approved height relief for a 13-building data center campus near Kings Highway and Bloomsbury Road.
notes: Project website says 352-acre site and 6.5M sq ft at full buildout by 2037; local news says 13 data center buildings on about 300 acres with 6.5M sq ft proposed.

status_detail: King George County Board of Supervisors approved Oasis Digital Properties' Dahlgren West campus in 2025; project described as 10 buildings totaling about 6.8M sq ft on roughly 485 acres north of James Madison Parkway.
notes: Capacity from Cleanview/DCD; Oasis official site confirms King George address and Dahlgren West project but exposes limited specs in crawlable text.

status_detail: Checked King William County official site/search, local discussion, and news/social search. Found a 2026 technology/data-center ordinance and public survey/opposition process, but no named developer, site application, permit, approval, or project record.
notes: County appears to be considering whether/how to allow technology uses such as data centers along Routes 30/360 and industrial zones; record kept as no project because ordinance work is not a project.

status_detail: Checked King and Queen County official packets/minutes and local reporting. County discussed solar/data-center zoning and rumors about a Canterbury Road/EDA site, but official minutes state no application and no county approach for a data center project.
notes: Board chair reportedly said there was no planned data center on Canterbury Road or anywhere else in the county at that time; planning work is zoning preparedness, not a project.

project_name: AWS Louisa County Technology Overlay District Campuses
status_detail: Louisa County announced AWS planned an $11B investment by 2040 to establish two data center campuses in the county's Technology Overlay District; county FAQ says construction could start as soon as 2024 with projected 15-year buildout.
notes: County FAQ references North Creek Technology Campus infrastructure and Lake Anna Technology Campus historical-resource question, indicating the two-campus framework.

aliases: Amazon Lake Anna data center campus
status_detail: Amazon filed for a Lake Anna Tech Campus in Louisa County; DCD describes six two-story buildings plus one smaller two-story building on 153 acres near Kentucky Road/Haley Drive, totaling about 1.7M sq ft.
notes: County FAQ and DEQ reporting tie AWS/Lake Anna water and discharge permitting to this campus; project-level square footage from DCD.

project_name: EdgeCore Shannon Hill Louisa County Campus
aliases: Shannon Hill Regional Business Park data center
status_detail: EdgeCore purchased 697 acres in Shannon Hill Regional Business Park and announced a 1.1+GW campus; official location page says 3.1M sq ft across six data centers, while press release says 3.9M sq ft and $17B+ investment.
notes: Louisa County says Shannon Hill was zoned in 2019 for technology-based uses including data center development and sold to EdgeCore for $42M.
